note: The six controlled tasks of the north-star benchmark. This file is safe to show a participant: it holds the symptom and the interaction, and no answer. The answer key is benchmark/answers.json, which a participant never opens.

tasks.title: A scene that redraws itself for nothing
tasks.symptom: Moving the pointer over the scene feels sluggish, and nothing on screen is changing.
tasks.interaction: Move the pointer slowly back and forth across the scene for ten seconds.

tasks.title: A canvas resized to the size it already is
tasks.design: one canvas whose backing store is reassigned per frame
tasks.symptom: The animation stutters, and it gets worse the longer it runs.
tasks.interaction: Watch the animation for ten seconds, then drag the slider from end to end twice.

tasks.title: A small chart with a very large backing store
tasks.design: one canvas whose backing store far exceeds its displayed size
tasks.symptom: A chart that occupies a corner of the page costs as much as a full-screen one.
tasks.interaction: Press Redraw ten times, then resize the browser window once.

tasks.title: A paint style rebuilt for every shape
tasks.design: one canvas drawing many shapes per frame
tasks.symptom: Drawing three hundred tiles is far slower than drawing three hundred rectangles should be.
tasks.interaction: Press Animate and let it run for ten seconds.

tasks.title: A colour picker that reads the canvas back every frame
tasks.design: one canvas read back through getImageData while drawing
tasks.symptom: The picker is smooth until the pointer enters the canvas, then the whole page stalls.
tasks.interaction: Move the pointer across the canvas for ten seconds.

tasks.title: The expensive canvas is not the one on screen
tasks.design: a cheap visible canvas composited from an expensive cache canvas
tasks.symptom: The visible canvas draws one image per frame, and the page is still slow.
tasks.interaction: Drag the pointer across the visible canvas for ten seconds.
